```json
{"bugs_found": ["Parser.times uses `elif times > min` instead of `elif times >= min`, causing off-by-one: when exactly `min` matches succeed and the next attempt fails, the parser returns failure rather than succeeding with the collected values. This breaks contract of `times`/`many`/`at_least`/`at_most`/`optional`/`sep_by`/`until` indirectly — e.g. `many()` of a parser that fails on first try returns failure instead of `[]` (min=0, times=0, 0>0 is False)."], "verdict": "REQUEST_CHANGES"}
```
